newsitem.title: USA: Vencor paid $4.5 mln in Colo. MEDtech shr buy.
newsitem.headline: Vencor paid $4.5 mln in Colo. MEDtech shr buy.

text.p: Vencor Inc, the largest shareholder of Colorado MEDtech Inc, paid $4.5 million to exercise warrants and purchase 2.0 million additional common shares in the company, Colorado MEDtech comptroller Greg Gould said Wednesday.
Colorado MEDtech earlier said the latest share purchase raised Vencor's stake in the company to 39 percent, from 21 percent.
Vencor is a long-term healthcare company while Colorado MEDtech designs and manufactures electronic and electromechanical products and software systems for the medical device industry.
